name: computed-insert-patch-recompute
$comment: ENH-028 computed fields on the write path: `fullName` is concat(first, " ", last). An insert carrying a client-supplied `fullName` ("WRONG") has it overwritten by the stamp (step 1 — the txn result is {} after `id` normalize); a patch to the input `first` re-derives it from the merged doc (step 2: Gracie→Grace yields "Grace Hopper"). The follow-up collect over the `by_fullName` index in desc order pins that the typed computed column serves the scan — Grace Hopper, Alan Turing, Ada Lovelace — and the exact 3-row array pins the row count over the indexed computed field (the count terminal over the same index stays pinned in server/tests/computed_test.rs). Mirrors computed_test.rs (1), (2), (5).
